_comment: FROZEN shrink-only baseline of deprecated `cloud-` names (directories, Cargo package names, Helm chart names) present today. Growth is RED; shrink is the point. Edit this file BY HAND in the SAME change as the rename, so it never overstates the remaining debt — the gate prints the exact lines to delete. There is deliberately no regeneration command: a tool that rewrites this file from the working tree is the baseline-laundering path that loading from the protected merge-base exists to prevent. NOTE: the oya-cloud-ci-* names are LIVE merge machinery (the required test job binds oya-cloud-ci-accounting-registry-app via OYA_CI_PRODUCER_BIN) — renaming one means moving that binding in the same change.
